title.narrative: Ensuring Continuity of Learning and Strengthening Resilient Education Systems

description.narrative: UNESCO will support Yemen and the Gulf States in ensuring continuity of learning during crises while strengthening education systems for greater resilience. The approach combines immediate emergency response with long-term system strengthening, integrating risk-informed planning, preparedness, and recovery. It focuses on enhancing national capacities, governance, and data systems to anticipate and respond to shocks. Priority actions include sustaining inclusive learning through flexible modalities, equipping educators with crisis-response skills, and embedding resilience in policies and curricula. Through partnerships and national ownership, UNESCO aims to contribute to build adaptive, inclusive, and crisis-resilient education systems.
